summary: Online store where customers browse products, buy them and track orders.
requirements: Customers browse and search a product catalogue
Customers add products to a cart and check out with a payment provider
Customers see the status of their orders

architecture.decision: A single web frontend and one backend API with one database. The storefront and the API have different release cadences and toolchains, so they are separate repositories. A modular monolith backend was preferred over microservices: one team, modest scale, and no independent scaling need yet. Payment is delegated to a hosted provider so card data never touches our systems.

repositories.testing: Unit tests with Vitest; end-to-end checkout flow with Playwright in CI
repositories.setup: Install Node.js 20, run `npm ci`, then `npm run dev`.

repositories.purpose: Backend API for catalogue, cart, orders and admin
repositories.testing: pytest unit and API tests against a disposable PostgreSQL container in CI
repositories.setup: Install Python 3.12, run `pip install -e .[dev]`, then `uvicorn app.main:app --reload`.
